newsitem.title: USA: Wave Systems shoots for profit in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Wave Systems shoots for profit in 1998.

text.p: Wave Systems Corp said Thursday it expects higher second and third quarter revenues and hopes to see a profit around Christmas 1998.
At its annual meeting, the company said its loss per share for the second quarter will be roughly equal to the $0.17 per share it lost in the first quarter of 1997.

Wave executives said the key to turning a profit will come if it can form a deal to bundle its specialty chips and software with a major computer maker. The company said it is currently in talks with "most of the major computer makers," and is aiming to have a contract by the beginning of 1998.
Wave Systems makes and sells an electronic commerce network for computers and the internet. Customers can buy or rent computer games, articles, recipes and other products for a few cents or dollars.

The company expects to report second quarter revenues of more than a thousand dollars around Aug 15. It also said it expects to have third quarter revenues of at least a million dollars from its new licensing deal with Internet Technology Group Plc of Britain.
